verses.1: Have they appointed you as a leader? Do not be willing to be extolled. Be among them as one of them.
verses.2: Have concern for them, and in this way sit down with them, and when you have explained all your concerns, sit back.
verses.3: Then you may rejoice because of them, and you may receive a crown as an adornment of grace, and so obtain the dignity of the assembly.
verses.4: Speak, you who are greater by birth. For it is fitting for you
verses.5: to speak the first word with careful knowledge. But you should not hinder the music.
verses.6: Where no one is listening, you should not pour out words. And do not choose to be extolled improperly for your wisdom.
verses.7: A gemstone of garnet is set amid an ornament of gold, and a concert of music is set amid a banquet of wine.
verses.8: Just as a signet of emerald is set amid a work of gold, so is a melody of music set amid delightful and moderate wine.
verses.9: Listen silently, and for your reverence, good graces will be added to you.
verses.10: Young man, speak in your own case only reluctantly.
verses.11: If you have been asked twice, let your response be concise.
verses.12: In many matters, be as if you lack knowledge, and listen silently as well as intently.
verses.13: In the midst of great men, you should not be presumptuous. And where the elders are present, you should not speak much.
verses.14: Lightning goes before a hailstorm, and grace goes before modesty. And so, for your reverence, good graces will be added to you.
verses.15: And at the hour for rising, you should not be lax. Later, be the first to run ahead to your house, and there withdraw, and there take your pastime.
verses.16: And act according to your intentions, but not in sin and not in arrogant speech.
verses.17: And for all these things, bless the Lord, who made you, and who fills you to overflowing with all his good things.
verses.18: Whoever fears the Lord will accept his doctrine. And whoever watches for him diligently will find a blessing.
verses.19: Whoever seeks the law will be filled from the law. But whoever acts with treachery will be scandalized by treachery.
verses.20: Those who fear the Lord will find just judgment, and they will kindle justice like a light.
verses.21: A sinful man will shun correction, and he will find a rationalization in accord with his own will.
verses.22: A man of counsel will not reject understanding. A strange and arrogant man will not be disturbed by fear.
verses.23: Even so, after he has acted out of fear and without counsel, he will be rebuked by his own criticism.
verses.24: Son, you should do nothing without counsel, and then you will not regret what you have done.
verses.25: You should not go into the way of ruin, and you then will not stumble on stones. You should not commit yourself to a laborious way; otherwise, you may set up a scandal against your own soul.
verses.26: And be cautious concerning your own sons. And be attentive to those of your own household.
verses.27: In all of your works, trust your soul to faith. For this is the keeping of the commandments.
verses.28: Whoever believes God attends to the commandments. And whoever trusts in him will not be diminished. [ Sirach 33 ]
